Package com.bupt.ta.ai

Class HttpLmClient

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.ai.HttpLmClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
LmClient
public final class HttpLmClient extends Object implements LmClient
HTTPS JSON implementation of LmClient for OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions APIs.

HttpLmClient is the production-oriented backend of the LM integration layer. It is constructed by LmClientFactory when LmConfig.getProviderType() is LmProviderType.OPENAI or LmProviderType.CUSTOM and LmConfig.hasHttpCredentials() is true. All vendor-specific concerns—URL assembly, Authorization header, JSON body shape, response parsing, and SSE streaming—are encapsulated here so servlets and AI services only see LmRequest and LmResponse.

Configuration used: LmConfig.getBaseUrl(), LmConfig.getHttpChatPath(), LmConfig.getApiKey(), LmConfig.getTimeoutMs(), and LmConfig.getModel() (with per-request override via LmRequest.getModel() and final fallback to LmModelDefaults.CHAT_FALLBACK).

Fallback behaviour: If credentials are missing, both generate(LmRequest) and stream(LmRequest, LmStreamListener) throw LmException. Provider error JSON is converted to unsuccessful LmResponse or LmStreamListener.onError(String) rather than throwing when the HTTP call succeeds but the payload contains an error object.

Vendor-specific differences (Azure api-version, Gemini/Claude adapters, custom headers) should stay inside this class; see inline TODO markers.

  • Method Details

    • generate

      public LmResponse generate(LmRequest request) throws LmException
      Performs a synchronous Chat Completions request and returns a normalised response.

      Builds an OpenAI-compatible JSON body from LmRequest.getMessages() or, when empty, from LmRequest.getSystemPrompt() and LmRequest.getUserPrompt(). Posts to baseUrl + httpChatPath with a Bearer token from LmConfig.getApiKey().

      Specified by:
      generate in interface LmClient
      Parameters:
      request - completion parameters and prompts; must not be null
      Returns:
      LmResponse with assistant text on success, or success=false with LmResponse.getErrorMessage() when the provider returns an error object or assistant text cannot be parsed
      Throws:
      LmException - if LmConfig.hasHttpCredentials() is false, JSON body construction fails, or the HTTP transport throws

    • stream

      public void stream(LmRequest request, LmStreamListener listener) throws LmException
      Streams a Chat Completions response via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

      Sends "stream": true in the request body, reads data: lines from the response, forwards delta.content fragments to LmStreamListener.onDelta(String), and completes on [DONE] or end-of-stream. Provider errors invoke LmStreamListener.onError(String) without throwing.

      Specified by:
      stream in interface LmClient
      Parameters:
      request - same shape as generate(LmRequest)
      listener - streaming callbacks; must not be null
      Throws:
      LmException - if credentials are missing, the request body cannot be built, or streaming I/O fails before a terminal listener callback
